title: feat: grant a model or account permission from errors and chat
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added a focused /grant page for approving one model ID, model category, or account permission on an existing key. It asks for a single model when the key lists model IDs, or the category when the key is category-only, and uses PATCH /account/keys/:id to preserve the key’s budget, expiry, and other permissions. Fixable refusals now use a shared link: model-access failures can return a chat reply linking to /grant, while JSON and audio requests keep their 403 and receive the link in error.fixUrl. Sandbox permission failures link to /grant?permission=machines instead of the key editor. Insufficient key budget or wallet funds link to this environment’s /edit-key or /top-up, including ref and redirect; reservation-race errors use those links too. TEXT_PERMISSION_NOTICE_ENABLED can disable the chat reply independently of the existing balance switch. /grant and /edit-key share a key card, and keys from connected apps show the consent screen’s app card. For refused agent runs, /grant can identify the agent and owner after Enter verifies a run-token claim bound to the key, grant, and agent; the page keeps the key card prominent and explains that approval applies to the whole key. Added agent_grant referral tracking.
